# Brnos Aires Tango Marathon

> Annual tango marathon in Brno, Czech Republic. 16–18 October 2026. 200 m² wooden floor, ~150 experienced dancers, healthy civilised hours, closed embrace, catered by a local Italian bakery. Organised by the Brnos Aires community.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://brnosaires.com/marathon/): Overview — music, floor, atmosphere, prices, and organisers
- [Schedule](https://brnosaires.com/marathon-schedule/): Over 30 hours of dancing across 3 days, civilised hours (1pm–midnight), no scheduled pauses
- [Venue](https://brnosaires.com/marathon-venue/): Dělnický dům, Jamborova 65, Brno — 200 m² wooden floor, on-site restaurant
- [DJs](https://brnosaires.com/marathon-djs-team/): Confirmed TDJs — dancers who DJ, selected for floor awareness
- [Travel](https://brnosaires.com/marathon-getting-to-brno/): Getting to Brno by plane, train, or bus from Vienna, Prague, and Bratislava
- [Registration](https://form.jotform.com/260266376011047): Full pass registration form — €125 solo, €230 couple, €30 youth (under 26)

## Optional

- [Stay in Brno](https://brnosaires.com/marathon-stay-in-brno/): Accommodation tips and city guide for marathon participants
- [Gallery](https://brnosaires.com/marathon-gallery/): Photos from previous editions
- [Conditions](https://brnosaires.com/marathon-conditions/): Full pass rules, venue conduct, cancellation policy
